name: @masahirompp/whatnext
description: A terminal list of your parallel Claude Code sessions, grouped by repository, with dependent sessions nested together.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && if [ -f dist/src/cli.js ]; then chmod +x dist/src/cli.js; fi
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --dir test/e2e --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout 60000
scripts.test:real: npm run build && vitest run --dir test/real --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout 600000 --hookTimeout 120000
